title: The agent with too many keys
scenario:
You run operations at a 15-person design studio. The studio uses Claude on a Team plan, and people are starting to hand whole tasks to Claude Cowork. A few also test ChatGPT Work. Before you write a one-page guide for the team, you collect four plans from colleagues.

Use the exhibit. The studio, people and plans are made up for this case. Product facts are from the vendors' help pages in October 2026.
exhibit:
DESK AGENT PLANS (made up)

  A. Lena (also testing ChatGPT Work): "I'll run my
     Work tasks locally, so the client files never
     leave my laptop at all."

  B. Tom: "I gave Cowork my whole Documents folder.
     It has client work, but also payroll and my
     tax papers. Easier than picking folders."

  C. Finance: "One task reads the supplier inbox
     (anyone can email it) and pays the invoices
     it finds on our bank site. No approvals."

  D. Ines: "I'm trying a new invoicing plugin for the
     first time today, on real client data."

questions.prompt: Plan A: what is true about Lena's local Work tasks?

options.text: Local tasks run fully offline, so no file content is sent out
options.explanation: OpenAI says file excerpts, prompts or tool results may be sent to its services to complete a task.

options.text: Parts of the files can still be sent to the vendor for the task
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI: relevant file excerpts, prompts, screenshots or tool results may be sent to its services. Local does not mean the data stays on the laptop.

options.text: Local tasks can only read files, so they never change anything
options.explanation: No page says that. A desk agent can read, write and delete files in folders it can reach.

options.text: ChatGPT Work can't run locally, so every task is in the cloud
options.explanation: OpenAI describes local Work, which uses approved resources on your computer, and cloud Work.

questions.prompt: Plan B: what should Tom do instead?

options.text: Keep the folder, and ask Cowork never to open the payroll files
options.explanation: A request is not a limit. Anthropic says Claude can read, write and delete files in the folders you connect.

options.text: Move the folder to the cloud, since cloud tasks are sealed off
options.explanation: Anthropic: isolation limits where the code runs, not what Claude reads or does.

options.text: Connect one working folder for Claude and back up key files
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic suggests a dedicated working folder instead of broad access, and backups of important files.

options.text: Rename the payroll files so the agent can't recognize them
options.explanation: The agent can still open them. Only connect the folders it needs.

questions.prompt: Plan C: why is this task the riskiest one?

options.text: It reads mail from anyone and can also pay with no approval
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic: prompt injection needs both things at once, reading untrusted content and the power to act. This task has both.

options.text: Reading an inbox uses more of the plan than paying invoices
options.explanation: Usage is not the risk here. The danger is a hidden order in an email that the agent can act on.

options.text: Bank sites always block desk agents, so the task will fail
options.explanation: No page says that. The task may well run, and that is the risk.

options.text: Invoices are PDFs, and a desk agent can't read any PDF files
options.explanation: No page says that. The problem is untrusted content plus the power to pay.

questions.prompt: Plan D: which approval mode fits Ines's first run?

options.text: Skip all approvals, so the new plugin can finish faster
options.explanation: In Skip mode nothing checks the actions. Use it only for low-risk work you can undo.

options.text: Manually approve, since the plugin is new and the data is real
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic says to switch to Manually approve for a new tool, plugin or site, and for sensitive files.

options.text: Any mode, because a new plugin always asks before it acts
options.explanation: No page says a new plugin always asks. The mode decides when Claude stops to ask.

options.text: Skip approvals today, and switch to manual if anything breaks
options.explanation: A mistake may be hard to undo by then. Anthropic says to start in Manually approve with a new plugin.
